summary: Backend-only cross-DB isolation verification for mobile backend. 11/11 pytest cases PASS. Confirmed mobile backend identity (service='parlourpilot-api'), Atlas ParlourPilot DB is clean (0 tenants, 1 platform_admin user after teardown), demo seed is disabled after restart (log line 'Demo seed disabled (ENABLE_DEMO_SEED != true) — skipping Glow Up seed' observed post-restart), platform admin login works, signup+login round trip works, and a tenant created via https://parlourpilot.com/api/tenants/signup is NOT visible in the mobile backend's DB — so the two backends ARE writing to separate databases (as the user noted). The mobile side is correctly configured. To share the DB, the WEB backend's MONGO_URL+DB_NAME env must be updated to match.
action_items: None for the mobile repo — mobile backend is correctly bound to Atlas cluster slaon-master.8oc5pjc.mongodb.net DB=ParlourPilot and demo seed is opt-in.

OUT OF SCOPE (web repo): To make the web app share the same DB, update https://parlourpilot.com deployment's env vars: MONGO_URL=mongodb+srv://parlourpilot:...@slaon-master.8oc5pjc.mongodb.net/... and DB_NAME=ParlourPilot, then redeploy. Verify via GET /api/health returning service='parlourpilot' but signup on either side becoming visible on the other.
critical_code_review_comments: startup.py:229 correctly gates demo seed behind ENABLE_DEMO_SEED — default off is safe for production Atlas.
seed_platform_admin() always runs when PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD is set — required for SaaS ops, verified.
One test-side quirk: the platform tenants endpoint returns a raw list (not {tenants: [...]}), test handles both shapes; no code change needed.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test tenants during the run (TEST_mobile_iso_<ts>@resend.dev on mobile, TEST_crossdb_verify_<ts>@resend.dev on web). Mobile tenants deleted via DELETE /api/platform/tenants/{tid}. Final mobile DB: 0 tenants, 1 user (platform_admin). Web tenant remains in web DB (out of our reach — expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile backend is confirmed pointed at Atlas cluster slaon-master.8oc5pjc.mongodb.net DB=ParlourPilot. platform@parlourpilot.com / platform123 works. admin@glowup.com no longer exists (401). To re-seed demo data, set ENABLE_DEMO_SEED=true in /app/backend/.env and restart backend.
rca_of_issue: User's observation is correct: mobile and web backends write to separate DBs. Root cause is that only the mobile backend's env vars were updated to the shared Atlas cluster — the web backend at parlourpilot.com is still bound to its own DB (evidence: GET https://parlourpilot.com/api/health returns service='parlourpilot' vs mobile 'parlourpilot-api', and a tenant created via web signup does NOT appear in the mobile Atlas DB even though the mobile backend now points at cluster slaon-master.8oc5pjc.mongodb.net). Mitigation: update the WEB deployment's MONGO_URL and DB_NAME to match the mobile config, then redeploy the web app. This is out of scope for the mobile repo.
